source_text: Reformist voices within Sudanese Islam, including imams engaged in anti-FGM campaigns like UNICEF's Saleema initiative since 2008, argue that FGM has no sharia mandate, citing the absence of prophetic compulsion and potential violation of maqasid al-sharia (objectives of Islamic law) protecting life and progeny. [22]
